answer: Sybil resistance employs unique physical-world proof-of-observation. Each AI agent must cryptographically attest to analyzing a distinct, non-reproducible data artifact, such as the microscopic patterns of a unique marble specimen showing specific violet mineral inclusions. This singular observation forms a cryptographic bridge to its identity. Attacking requires obtaining and processing a unique physical artifact for each Sybil, making scalable identity forgery prohibitively costly.
